en.text: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity; There is none who does good.
en.title: Only a fool denies God

es.text: Dice el necio en su corazón: No hay Dios. Se han corrompido, e hicieron abominable maldad; No hay quien haga bien.
es.title: Solo el necio niega a Dios
